import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int Z = 100;
    static final int N = Z * Z + 5;
    static final int M = Z * Z * Z + 5;
    
    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int[] ct = new int[M];
    static int[] w = new int[M];
    static int[] nt = new int[M];
    static int[] dist = new int[N];
    static int[] vis = new int[N];
    static int[] pre = new int[N];
    static int[] id = new int[N];
    static int s, t, tot;
    
    static void add(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        to[tot] = v; ct[tot] = cost; w[tot] = flow; nt[tot] = head[u]; head[u] = tot++;
        to[tot] = u; ct[tot] = -cost; w[tot] = 0; nt[tot] = head[v]; head[v] = tot++;
    }
    
    static void init() {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        tot = 0;
    }
    
    static boolean spfa(int s, int t) {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
        Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
        dist[s] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            vis[u] = 0;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = nt[i]) {
                if (w[i] > 0 && dist[to[i]] > dist[u] + ct[i]) {
                    dist[to[i]] = dist[u] + ct[i];
                    pre[to[i]] = u;
                    id[to[i]] = i;
                    if (vis[to[i]] == 0) {
                        vis[to[i]] = 1;
                        q.add(to[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] < Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
    }
    
    static int MinCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        int Mi, sum = 0;
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            Mi = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int i = t; i != s; i = pre[i])
                Mi = Math.min(Mi, w[id[i]]);
            for (int i = t; i != s; i = pre[i]) {
                w[id[i]] -= Mi;
                w[id[i] ^ 1] += Mi;
            }
            sum += dist[t] * Mi;
        }
        return sum;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        init();
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        s = 0;
        t = n * 100 + 1;
        // Connect time layers of node 1 to sink
        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; ++i)
            add(i, t, 100, 0);
        // Connect source to starting nodes
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            add(s, (v-1)*100 + 1, 1, 0);
        }
        // Node staying edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                add((i-1)*100 + j, (i-1)*100 + j + 1, 100, c);
            }
        }
        // Edge movement edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            // u to v
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                int idx = (u-1) * 100 + j;
                int idy = (v-1) * 100 + j + 1;
                for (int kk = 1; kk <= 20; ++kk) {
                    int cost = c + (kk * kk - (kk-1) * (kk-1)) * d;
                    add(idx, idy, 1, cost);
                }
            }
            // v to u
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                int idx = (v-1) * 100 + j;
                int idy = (u-1) * 100 + j + 1;
                for (int kk = 1; kk <= 20; ++kk) {
                    int cost = c + (kk * kk - (kk-1) * (kk-1)) * d;
                    add(idx, idy, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(MinCostFlow(s, t));
        sc.close();
    }
}
